reviews.text: 目元のシワや乾燥が気になってアイパッチを探していたところビタミンC系のものを見つけて購入しました。パッチ自体は普通のサイズで目元にぴったりと張り付いてくれるので剥がれにくいタイプだと思います。15分くらいつけていますが、肌が保湿されている気がします。
reviews.zh: 留意到眼周嘅皺紋同乾燥，所以搵緊 eye patch 嘅時候見到維他命 C 類就買咗。Patch 本身係普通 size，但係可以緊貼眼周，我覺得係唔容易甩嗰種。敷咗大概 15 分鐘，覺得皮膚有保濕到。

reviews.text: It’s my first time using this product and it absolutely the best eye pads I ever used, the gel is cooling and relaxing and the results is amazing. I use it as an overnight eye mask. 100 % satisfaction!
reviews.zh: 第一次用呢件產品，絕對係我用過最好嘅 eye pad，gel 涼涼哋好 relax，效果一流。我當 overnight eye mask 用。100% 滿意！

reviews.text: I like these patches for eyes. They add a lot of hydration. They are fairly slippery but they do adhere quite well. It's quite nice to put them on and leave them for a bit while you're doing other things. I noticed that I can get away with using a lot less eye cream after having these on in the morning.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢啲眼用 patch。非常保濕。雖然幾滑但係都貼得好穩。貼住之後等一陣先拎走，做其他嘢嗰陣都好方便。我留意到朝早用完之後可以少用好多 eye cream。

reviews.text:
The goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Patches are super refreshing and perfect for tired under eyes. They feel cooling and hydrating right away, and after consistent use, my under-eye area looked brighter and smoother. The patches stay in place well and leave my skin feeling plump without irritation.

I also noticed makeup applied more smoothly after using them. While the brightening results aren’t instant, they definitely help improve dullness and tired-looking eyes over time. Great for a quick self-care boost and everyday hydration.
reviews.zh:
goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Patches 感覺超級清爽，非常適合疲勞嘅眼底。即時有涼感同保濕效果，持續用落之後，我嘅眼底睇落更亮更平滑。眼貼貼得好穩，皮膚感覺飽滿又唔刺激。

用完之後化妝都更加貼服。雖然提亮效果唔係即時見到，但長期用落確實有助改善暗沉同疲態。適合快速自我療癒同日常保濕。

reviews.text: Only complaint I have with this product is that they are hard to grab with the plastic tweezers they provide so I just end up using my fingers.
reviews.zh: 對呢件產品唯一嘅投訴係跟機附送嘅膠鉗好難夾起嚟，所以最後都係直接用手指。

reviews.text: Lightweight texture absorbed quickly, calmed redness, and improved skin clarity within weeks. Gentle, non-irritating, and hydrating, it layered well under makeup and left my skin smooth all day long daily.
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈，吸收得快，幾星期內就舒緩咗泛紅，膚色更見透徹。溫和唔刺激又保濕，搽完化妝前打底一流，每日都用全日皮膚都保持平滑。

reviews.text:
Good product, comfortable to wear and use, I will finish the whole jar, but I might not repurchase and try something else. 
This product is good and comfortable to wear and use. I’ll finish the whole jar but I might not repurchase and try something else.
reviews.zh:
產品唔錯，貼住又好用，我會用完成罐，但未必會回購，可能會試其他嘢。
呢件產品好，貼住又好用。我會用完成罐，但未必會回購，可能會試其他嘢。

reviews.text: There is a lot of product in the pot which is a plus each eye patch is drenched in it, and although a lot of product has benefits it does mean the patch tends to slip around a bit initially. However with perseverance the product with absorb into the skin and keep the patch in place. The eye patches do leave a nice smooth finish after use but only time will tell if this makes a constant and lasting improvement
reviews.zh: 罐入面有好多精華，每片眼貼都浸滿，呢個係優點。雖然精華多有好處，但即係眼貼頭先會容易滑走。不過只要忍一忍，產品就會畀皮膚吸收，眼貼亦會貼返穩。眼貼用完之後的確會留低一個好平滑嘅妝效，但係咪可以持續咁改善，就要時間去証明。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
